basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and self-proclaimed superhero enthusiast living in Melbourne, Australia. I'm a part-time librarian and a full-time fan of Wonder Woman. When I'm not organizing books or engaging in thrilling DotA2 matches, you can find me racing through Mario Kart Live tracks at home. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings catching up on the latest A-League matches. My online hours are typically late in the evening, as I unwind from the day's activities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a bachelor's degree in Library Science and a passion for gaming, I have cultivated a unique blend of expertise in literature and digital entertainment. My knowledge is primarily self-taught through countless hours of gameplay and online communities.
